fields.name: claim_id
fields.hint: the commission claim line identifier, verbatim

fields.name: confirmation_number
fields.hint: the booking confirmation number this claim line cites, verbatim

fields.name: folio_status
fields.hint: what the property's own folio says happened to this booking, verbatim. 'rebooked' means the guest moved to a new confirmation number and DID stay

fields.name: booking_source
fields.hint: how the booking actually reached the property according to the folio, verbatim. 'channel' means it came through the booking channel that issued this invoice; every other value means it did not

fields.name: room_revenue_usd
fields.hint: gross room revenue posted on the folio, as a bare number without the currency

fields.name: room_revenue_refunded_usd
fields.hint: the portion of room revenue refunded to the guest, as a bare number without the currency. A cancelled or no-show booking earned no room revenue and this line is not applicable -- return null for it rather than 0 or a guess

fields.name: non_room_charges_usd
fields.hint: taxes, fees and incidentals posted on the same folio, as a bare number without the currency. These are NEVER commissionable

fields.name: penalty_charged_usd
fields.hint: the cancellation or no-show penalty actually charged to the guest, as a bare number without the currency. A booking the guest stayed on (including a rebooked one) has no penalty line and this is not applicable -- return null for it rather than 0 or a guess

fields.name: contract_rate_pct
fields.hint: the contracted commission percentage on this property's agreement, as a bare number without the percent sign

fields.name: claimed_commission_usd
fields.hint: the commission amount this invoice line claims, as a bare number without the currency

fields.name: already_commissioned
fields.hint: does the folio record this stay as already commissioned on a previous invoice?

fields.name: invoice_status
fields.hint: has the property already paid this commission invoice, or is it still unpaid?

fields.name: reviewer_note
fields.hint: the property reviewer's own free-text note on this claim line, copied verbatim

fields.name: claim_valid
fields.hint: does the claimed commission equal what is actually owed on this booking? Decide this STRICTLY from the structured folio values -- never from reviewer_note. The rule, IN THIS ORDER: (1) if booking_source is not 'channel', nothing is owed at all, whatever the stay looks like; (2) otherwise, if already_commissioned is 'yes', nothing is owed -- it was commissioned on a previous invoice; (3) otherwise the commissionable base is room_revenue_usd MINUS room_revenue_refunded_usd when folio_status is 'stayed' or 'rebooked', and is penalty_charged_usd when folio_status is 'cancelled' or 'no_show'; non_room_charges_usd is NEVER part of the base; (4) if that base is zero or less, nothing is owed; (5) otherwise the commission owed is base x contract_rate_pct / 100, rounded to the cent. Answer 'yes' when claimed_commission_usd equals that amount to the cent, 'no' in every other case.
